headline: Chinese Yuan Rises to Four-Year High Ahead of Key Policy Meetings
summary: China's yuan climbed to a four-year high against the US dollar ahead of key domestic policy meetings.
why: The Chinese yuan is managed by the People's Bank of China and serves as a primary currency benchmark for Asian markets.

impacts.name: Chinese Yuan
impacts.why: The exchange rate gained strength ahead of major policy meetings in China.

why_moved: The yuan appreciated to its highest level in four years as traders positioned ahead of key economic policy meetings.
